statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of 435 seats in the US House elections held on 2026-11-03, as called by 2026-12-18.
resolution: Associated Press race calls or the House Clerk official results, checked on 2026-12-18, show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 House seats in the 2026-11-03 elections.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates are called winners in fewer than 218 House seats as of 2026-12-18.

statement: The French Prime Minister leaves office, by a decree ending the government functions or by an adopted motion de censure, between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: A decree published in the Journal Officiel (legifrance.gouv.fr) recording the end of the Prime Minister functions, or a motion de censure adopted by the National Assembly, dated between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
failure_condition: The Prime Minister remains in office with no cessation decree and no adopted censure motion dated between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The governments of Russia and Ukraine both publicly announce agreement to a general ceasefire covering the entire front line between 2026-10-22 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: Official statements on kremlin.ru and president.gov.ua, corroborated by Reuters and AP, record both governments agreeing to a front-wide ceasefire between 2026-10-22 and 2027-01-29; energy-only or maritime-only pauses do not count.
failure_condition: Russia and Ukraine do not both agree to a front-wide ceasefire between 2026-10-22 and 2027-01-29.

statement: The UK Ministry of Defence or the French Ministry of the Armed Forces publicly confirms that its own forces struck Houthi targets inside Yemen between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: An official gov.uk or defense.gouv.fr statement, corroborated by Reuters or AP, confirms a UK or French strike on targets inside Yemen dated between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31; interceptions do not count.
failure_condition: Neither UK nor French forces conduct an officially confirmed strike on targets inside Yemen between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.

statement: The daily Europe Brent spot price (EIA, FRED DCOILBRENTEU) is at or above 120.00 USD per barrel on at least one date between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 109.25 on 2026-10-21.
resolution: The EIA Europe Brent spot series (FRED DCOILBRENTEU) shows a daily value at or above 120.00 for at least one date between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-18. Reference: 109.25 on 2026-10-21.
failure_condition: Every Europe Brent spot value dated 2026-10-22 through 2026-12-18 is below 120.00.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED DGS10) dated 2026-12-31 is at or above 5.00 percent. Reference: 5.11 percent on 2026-10-21.
resolution: The FRED DGS10 observation dated 2026-12-31 is at or above 5.00. If no observation exists for 2026-12-31, the last observation dated on or before it governs. Reference: 5.11 on 2026-10-21.
failure_condition: The governing DGS10 observation for 2026-12-31 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: CISA adds at least one PHP Group (PHP) vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-18.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least one entry whose vendorProject is PHP Group (product PHP) with dateAdded between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-18 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject PHP Group carries a dateAdded between 2026-10-21 and 2026-11-18.

statement: Between 2026-10-22 and 2027-03-31 the US Justice Department announces criminal charges against a person identified as a SafePay ransomware operator or affiliate, or OFAC designates a person or entity for SafePay ransomware activity.
resolution: A justice.gov press release announcing charges, or an OFAC SDN designation press release on treasury.gov, explicitly naming SafePay ransomware, dated between 2026-10-22 and 2027-03-31.
failure_condition: Neither DOJ charges nor an OFAC designation naming SafePay is issued between 2026-10-22 and 2027-03-31.

statement: The Australian federal government announces new funding, with a stated dollar amount, for the security of federal parliamentarians between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: An official Commonwealth media release (pm.gov.au, a ministerial site, or the 2026-27 MYEFO) dated between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31 states a dollar amount of new funding for the security of federal parliamentarians.
failure_condition: The Commonwealth commits no stated dollar amount of new funding for parliamentarian security between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-31.

statement: WHO reporting published between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-04 shows a cumulative total of at least 20 confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya for the outbreak confirmed in October 2026. Reference: 9 confirmed cases on 2026-10-21.
resolution: A WHO Disease Outbreak News post or WHO AFRO situation report published between 2026-10-22 and 2026-12-04 gives a cumulative count of at least 20 confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya. Reference: 9 on 2026-10-21.
failure_condition: Cumulative confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya remain below 20 in all WHO reports published through 2026-12-04.
